# Table export to Excel and PDF Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** One export any screen can hand its filtered rows to, returning an `.xlsx` or `.pdf` with a "Generated by" footer, plus a console command that exports any CSV the console writes.

**Architecture:** A plain model `ExportTable` (core/models), two pure builders in core/services (`table_export_xlsx.dart` over the existing `xlsx_writer.dart`, `table_export_pdf.dart` over the `pdf` package), and `TableExportViewModel` (both builds) that checks the sign-in, writes the footer from the signed-in user and the clock, and calls the builders. The console command goes through the ViewModel only (VM boundary).

**Tech Stack:** Dart 3, `pdf` 3.12.0 (new), BASA's own xlsx writer, flutter_test.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-28-table-export-design.md`

## Global Constraints

- No Flutter in core/ or viewmodels/; command files import only viewmodels/, core/models/, core/console/ and the SDK (`dart run tool/check_vm_boundary.dart`).
- Both builds (no admin marker); `dart run tool/check_tutor_imports.dart` stays OK.
- Footer, exactly: `Generated by <full name> (<role label>) on <d MMM yyyy>, <h:mm AM|PM>`; role labels `Admin`, `Coordinator`, `Tutor`, superadmin (admin with no school) `Admin, region`. Example: `Generated by Maria Santos (Coordinator) on 28 Nov 2026, 9:14 AM`. PDF adds `Page n of m` on every page. Device local time.
- File name: `<title> <yyyy-mm-dd>.<ext>`, characters `\ / : * ? " < > |` replaced by `-`.
- Messages a screen shows name no field, id, table or console command (lib/core/CLAUDE.md, owner 2026-11-17); not signed in = `notSignedInMessage`.
- PDF: A4, portrait up to 6 columns, landscape from 7; header row repeats every page; title block page 1 only; Helvetica; a character Helvetica can't show is replaced, never an error; no rows = header + `No rows`.
- Excel: one sheet named from the title (max 31 characters, `[ ] : * ? / \` removed, empty -> `Export`); rows: `BASA - <title>`, school / school year line (when given), filter lines, empty row, header, data, empty row, footer; number columns as numbers, text columns as text (`@`).
- `pdf` must resolve at 3.12.0 (3.13 needs xml ^7). Gate in Task 2: full `flutter test` passes after the package change (archive moves 4.5.2 -> 4.0.9); if not, STOP and ask the owner (no ruling).
- Owner commits; no git commands. Run `dart analyze` (0 errors) and both tool checks after every task. Never run analyze alongside `flutter test`. Steps with long runs carry **DO NOT PLAY RESOURCE INTENSIVE GAMES**.

## Review Focus

- An LRN column (12 digits, maybe a leading zero) exported from a CSV stays text in Excel, not `9.99E+11` -> Task 3 test `LRN column stays text`.
- A title with `/` or `:` ("Grade 7/8: Rizal") makes a valid sheet name and file name -> Task 1 test `title with forbidden characters`.
- A learner name with a character outside Latin-1 (e.g. `’` or `Ğ`) doesn't break the PDF -> Task 2 test `non-Latin-1 text is replaced`.
- 120 rows paginate with the header on every page and `Page n of m` -> Task 2 test `long table paginates`.
- A row with more values than columns is refused in plain words; a shorter one is padded -> Task 1 test `row lengths`.

**Files:**

**Interfaces:**
- Consumes: Task 1/2 ViewModel.
- Produces: `ExportTable TableExportViewModel.tableFromCsv(String csvText, String title, {String? school, String? schoolYear, List<String> filters = const []})` (sign-in checked; BOM stripped; first non-empty row = columns; empty rows skipped). A column is `number` when every non-empty cell is a number with no leading zero (`0` and `0.5` are fine) and at most 10 characters; else `text`. Number cells become `num`, empty cells `null`.
- Command: `export-table <in.csv> <out.xlsx|out.pdf> <title...> [school=<text>] [year=<text>] [filter=<text>]...` -> `Wrote <n> rows to <path>`; refusals: usage; `Use an output file ending in .xlsx or .pdf.`; `Couldn't read <path>: ...`; `Couldn't write <path>: ...` (same words as `export-section`).
